args.article: Today's AI agents landscape is evolving rapidly. Open-source agent frameworks have hit a production milestone with adoption tripling, while model-driven agents are quietly replacing hand-coded orchestration in startups. Tool-calling reliability has become the new benchmark for frontier models, and multi-agent swarms are transitioning from demos to regulated enterprise workflows. Meanwhile, observability standards are emerging to trace agent decisions end to end, marking a maturing ecosystem.
